ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json fun emailEnviado(value) = if(!isEmpty(value)) value.email.sended else false
fun hasFicheiroAssociado(notification, canceled, pending, billed) = !isBlank(vars.notificationFile) or !isBlank(vars.cancaledFile) or !isBlank(vars.pendingFile) or !isBlank(vars.billedFile)
fun statusFaturamento(canceled, pending, billed) = if(!isBlank(canceled)) 'Cancelado' else if (!isBlank(pending)) 'Pendente' else if (!isBlank(billed)) 'Faturado' else 'Não informado'
fun statusPagamento(canceled, pending, billed) = if(!isBlank(canceled)) 'Cancelado' else if (!isBlank(pending)) 'Pendente' else if (!isBlank(billed)) 'Autorizado' else 'Não informado'
fun statusReserva(canceled, pending, billed) = if(!isBlank(canceled)) 'Cancelada' else if (!isBlank(pending)) 'Pendente' else if (!isBlank(billed)) 'Aprovada' else 'Não informado' --- { "statusReserva": statusReserva(vars.cancaledFile, vars.pendingFile, vars.billedFile), "statusPagamento": statusPagamento(vars.cancaledFile, vars.pendingFile, vars.billedFile), "statusFaturamento": statusFaturamento(vars.cancaledFile, vars.pendingFile, vars.billedFile), "emailEnviado": emailEnviado(vars.notificationPayload), "hasFicheiroAssociado": hasFicheiroAssociado(vars.notificationFile, vars.cancaledFile, vars.pendingFile, vars.billedFile), "ficheirosAssociados": [ {notification: vars.notificationFile}, {billingCanceled: vars.cancaledFile}, {billingPending: vars.pendingFile}, {billingBilled: vars.billedFile} ] filter ((item) -> !isBlank(valuesOf(item)[0])) }
